messages:
Jordan: Hi @Sam — Taylor starts Monday. Can you drop a very short manager-first-week agenda and a tight 30/60/90 I can paste into the offer and calendar? Prefer role-specific (runtime).

Sam (People Ops): Sure — keeping it compact and copy/paste friendly. Assign Riley as buddy unless you want someone else.

Sam (People Ops): ```
First-week agenda (copy into calendar):
Day -1: 1Password invite, SSO/MFA, Slack + email created, hardware ship check
Day 0: 15m welcome, meet buddy (Riley), infra & product overview (45m)
Day 1: Local dev setup (pair with buddy, 2h), access review (model store, logs)
Day 2: Onboarding-safe issue + CI walkthrough (pair)
Day 3: Observability + tracing tour (30m), small doc/metric task assigned
Day 4: Ship first small PR, staging verification, 1:1 recap + 30/60/90 finalization
```

Sam (People Ops): Manager checklist (week 1): post intro in #company and #eng-runtime, schedule pairing slots, create labeled onboarding issue, queue security training, schedule weekly 1:1s for first 6 weeks.

Sam (People Ops): 30/60/90 (runtime — measurable):
- 30d: Env & infra access complete; 1 merged PR (AC: CI green, reviewer sign-off, deploy to staging)
- 60d: Own a small component and ship measurable improvement (AC: metric delta >=5% or reduced alert noise)
- 90d: Lead a rollout of optimization and be primary on an oncall rotation (AC: runbook updated, post-rollout review, no P0 regressions in 2w)

Jordan: Nice and concise. Who do we ping for fast-track Dedicated GPU access and KMS?

Sam (People Ops): eng-infra for GPU quotas (ticket prefix: onboard-gpu), Security for KMS (onboard-kms), IT Support for hardware/VPN. OnboardingBot will DM training reminders.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled — Security Foundations and Data Handling will DM Taylor on day 1 and day 8. Targets: basic by EOD day 3, full by day 14.

Taylor (New Hire): Laptop tracker shows "label created" — any ETA? Also where are the onboarding-safe issues?

IT Support: Hi Taylor — carrier delay, ETA ~24-48h. Please DM preferred delivery window. Onboarding-safe issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/onboarding-safe (pinned in #eng-runtime).

Riley (Buddy): Taylor — I'll DM you a Day 1 2h pairing block and add two safe starter PRs to the onboarding board. I'll also post a short checklist for local setup.

Jordan: I'll post the intro in #company Monday using Sam's blurb and schedule the 30-day retro. Thanks everyone.

Sam (People Ops): Copyable intro blurb: "Taylor joins as a Runtime Engineer working on serving performance and reliability. Fun fact: bakes challah on weekends. Welcome Taylor! :wave:"

Taylor (New Hire): Thanks all — excited to get started. One last: who approves short-term Dedicated GPU for experiments?

eng-infra: Raise a ticket with prefix "onboard-gpu" and CC Jordan. We'll fast-track 1 GPU for 30 days if approved.

Sam (People Ops): Final note — attach fillable 30/60/90 to calendar invites and include acceptance criteria bullets. If anything blocks, prefix tickets with "onboard-urgent" and tag IT Support + eng-infra. :white_check_mark:
